note: The fed's title history has Chris Taylor winning the Lightweight title from Matt Senate at Maximum Velocity on 4 May 2001. By the end of October 2001 the fed's title history marked the Lightweight title retired; Chris Taylor is its last champion on record. FSW's own card for the show this reign was won on is not held; the date is the fed's own.
